title: Crate Pusher
author: cobanov
description: A cosy 3D warehouse puzzle: push every crate onto its spot in 45 original levels, from tiny tutorials to real brain-teasers, and try to match each level's par.

controls.D-pad: Walk and push (hold to keep going); choose a level or a menu item
controls.A: Play the chosen level; next level; select in menus
controls.B: Undo (hold to rewind); resume (paused); level select (level clear)
